question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Section 22 13 16) before ordering material, citing supplier lead times.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping in lieu of no-hub cast-iron soil piping, provided equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings are submitted.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The substitution involves a plumbing piping specification, so it should be reviewed and approved by the plumbing engineer of record.
